description: This Swift source file defines a public enum 'CameraCapturePipelineSupport' containing static methods to prepare and manage camera sessions for photo and movie recording, including setup, error handling, and auxiliary functions related to camera configuration in an iOS application.

methods.name: preparePhotoSession
methods.description: Sets up an AVCaptureSession for taking photos, configuring input and output devices, throws error if setup fails.

methods.name: prepareMovieSession
methods.description: Configures an AVCaptureSession for video recording, including optional audio, and returns the session and output object.

methods.name: prepareWarmMovieSession
methods.description: Prepares a movie capture session asynchronously, starts it, warms it up, and returns the session and output.

methods.name: withWarmMovieSession
methods.description: Wraps the warm movie session preparation with a custom operation, ensuring proper start and stop of session.

methods.name: mapMovieSetupError
methods.description: Maps a session setup error to a specific error type, handling microphone unavailability.

methods.name: makePhotoSettings
methods.description: Creates and configures AVCapturePhotoSettings with preferred photo codec and quality settings.

methods.name: capturePhotoData
methods.description: Captures photo data asynchronously using a delegate created by the provided makeDelegate closure.

methods.name: warmUpCaptureSession
methods.description: Performs a small delay to improve capture stability on some devices.

methods.name: positionLabel
methods.description: Returns a string label for a given AVCaptureDevice position.
